title: Deep learning-guided discovery reveals the diversity and mutational potential of environmental beta-lactamases
abstract: arXiv:2611.14568v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Beta-lactamases are a major mechanism of bacterial resistance to beta-lactam antibiotics; however, their functional diversity and mutational potential in environmental microbial communities remain partially understood. This study aimed to characterize environmental beta-lactamase diversity and investigate how sequence variation influences antibiotic resistance. By integrating protein language model (PLMs) with ensemble learning, we identified more than 46,000 putative beta-lactamases across all four Ambler classes from environmental metagenomes, widely distributed across diverse habitats, with distinct habitat-associated class compositions. The candidates sharing approximately 30% sequence identity with known beta-lactamases conferred resistance to multiple beta-lactam antibiotics when expressed in Escherichia coli. translated_title: 深度学习引导的发现揭示环境β-内酰胺酶的多样性与突变潜力
translated_abstract: β-内酰胺酶是细菌对β-内酰胺类抗生素产生耐药性的主要机制；然而，它们在环境微生物群落中的功能多样性和突变潜力尚未被完全了解。本研究旨在表征环境β-内酰胺酶的多样性，并探究序列变异如何影响抗生素耐药性。通过将蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）与集成学习相结合，我们从环境宏基因组中鉴定出超过46,000个涵盖全部四个Ambler类别的推定β-内酰胺酶，这些酶广泛分布于多种栖息地，且不同栖息地具有独特的类别组成。与已知β-内酰胺酶共享约30%序列同一性的候选酶在大肠杆菌中表达时，赋予了对多种β-内酰胺类抗生素的耐药性。将逆折叠模型与蛋白质语言模型相结合，进一步鉴定出可改变耐药性谱的突变，包括取代……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本研究通过整合蛋白质语言模型与集成学习，从环境宏基因组中发现超过46,000个新型β-内酰胺酶，并利用逆折叠模型与蛋白质语言模型鉴定出改变抗生素耐药性的关键突变，揭示了环境β-内酰胺酶的多样性与突变潜力。
en_tdlr: By integrating protein language models with ensemble learning and inverse folding models, this study discovered over 46,000 putative beta-lactamases from environmental metagenomes and identified mutations that alter antibiotic resistance profiles, revealing the diversity and mutational potential of environmental beta-lactamases.
